messages:
miguel: Heads-up — CloudStack partner wants a hands-on lab to show our on‑prem marketplace + StackGen Terraform modules. They want a quick end-to-end: provision infra, deploy model bundle, run a smoke inference. Target next Tues.

sara: ok. can we scope a 60m lab? agenda: 1) overview + creds 2) run stackgen template 3) smoke infer + perf notes 4) Q&A. I'll draft a checklist.

harper: FYI the current stackgen module exposes a few vars that break ongov clouds (region vs region_code). we should either add validation or provide a presets file for gov regions.

oliver: i pushed a branch: github.com/redwood/stackgen/tree/partner-onprem-demo. contains terraform/marketplace-connector and examples/azure-ami + gcp-image. readme has quick creds steps.

miguel: nice. oliver can you add an example `presets/gov.tfvars`? short snippet:

```
region = "us-gov-west-1"
image  = "redwood/llm-runtime:2026-03"
license = "apache-2.0"
```

sara: also add an env var example for KMS/HSM integration and a note about NAT egress for private installs.

oliver: done, pushed presets and a small validation in `variables.tf` to warn if `region` looks gov but `image` is not signed.

harper: can we also surface a `--skip-module-signature-check` for dev labs? partner needs to run locally without their signing pipeline.

oliver: added `skip_signature_check = true` in examples, but default is false.

deploy-bot: CI: build/terraform-modules #462 passed — plan shows 0 destructive changes. (link: https://ci.redwood.dev/462)

maya: licensing Q — partner legal asked if they can rebrand the sample templates. answer?

sara: templates are Apache-2.0, rebranding ok but don't claim production support. we'll add a short LICENSE header in examples.

frank: i'll volunteer to run the lab on Tues at 10am PT and handle the smoke tests. can someone prepare a quick checklist with expected outputs and a simple inference curl we can run?

miguel: perfect. checklist draft in the repo under `.docs/lab-checklist.md`. expected outputs: "health: OK", model loads in <30s on a 16GB GPU instance, inference latency <300ms for short prompts.

frank: got it. i'll add the curl snippet:

curl -X POST https://{host}/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"prompt":"hello","max_tokens":8}'

harper: note: if partner uses older kernel images, KV cache may be slower. add a troubleshooting note about `CACHE_SIZE` and `kv_prefetch` toggles.

sara: we'll include a short slide on that. also include rollback instructions for canary model variants.

miguel: thanks team. can we do a final pre-lab dry run on Monday 3pm PT? oliver + frank + harper please.

oliver: yep

frank: yep

harper: i'll be there

sara: i'll join briefly to cover legal/license bits

miguel: great — I'll send the invite and attach the repo + checklist. tagging @everyone in the partner thread so they have the repo link and lab plan. :party_parrot:
